svg.title: Supia7 contribution garden
svg.desc: 365 consecutive days, 2025-10-14 through 2026-10-13; 142 contributions. Every soil tile is one day; moss, sprouts, ferns and trees encode GitHub's five contribution levels. Updated 2026-10-13. Contributions are not commits or a productivity score.
svg.text: One tile, one day. Contributions ≠ productivity.
